report.title: THE OCEANS AS A GLOBAL COMMONS: DOES MACHINE ADMINISTRATION CREATE A NEW WORLD ORDER WITHOUT ANNEXING THE SEAS?
report.summary: The strategic evolution of international waters in the twenty-first century hinges on a profound geopolitical divergence: the distinction between claiming territorial sovereignty over a domain and possessing absolute structural dominance over the infrastructure required to utilize that domain.…
